title: AAP Exclusive: Cramer Talks Tech and Why Alphabet is Worrisome
text:
In the May Action Alerts PLUS members' call, Jim Cramer talked about the AAP Porfolio's technology holdings.
"Our tech picks have continued to shine. Facebook ( FB ) , Apple ( AAPL ) , and Amazon ( AMZN ) deliver spectacular earnings. And we've made all the trims we need of the first two, and can't be much bigger in the latter, it is our largest position, he said.
He also talked about why the team thinks Microsoft ( MSFT ) is the "best of all worlds," why they would like Nvidia ( NVDA ) to come down in price and the one stock that worries them.
Wonder what it is ?
